headline: Fabtech Technologies CFO Kalpesh Chauhan resigns
summary: Fabtech Technologies Limited has officially notified the NSE of the resignation of its Chief Financial Officer, Kalpesh Chauhan. The resignation is effective from November 12, 2026. The company has not yet announced a successor for the role.
whats_next: Announcement of a new CFO appointment
why_it_matters: Leadership changes can signal internal shifts or impact near-term financial reporting.
